description: This file is a shell script used for managing network bridge services on a router or embedded device. It includes functions for bringing up and tearing down Ethernet and wireless interfaces, managing DHCP client handlers, configuring the network bridge, and controlling firewall rules. It orchestrates startup and shutdown sequences for network bridging, DHCP management, and related network configurations.

methods.name: unregister_dhcp_client_handlers
methods.description: Unregisters DHCP client event handlers by removing their async IDs from the system event registry.

methods.name: register_dhcp_client_handlers
methods.description: Registers DHCP client event handlers for restart, release, and renew events, setting options and storing async IDs.

methods.name: enslave_a_interface
methods.description: Aliases a network interface to a bridge by bringing it up, enabling multicast, and adding it to the bridge.

methods.name: bringup_ethernet_interfaces
methods.description: Placeholder function for bringing up Ethernet interfaces (currently does nothing).

methods.name: bringup_wireless_interfaces
methods.description: Configures wireless interfaces, sets hardware addresses, enables multicast, and runs configuration commands.

methods.name: teardown_wireless_interfaces
methods.description: Brings down wireless interfaces and related daemons.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Stops the firewall if it is running.

methods.name: add_ebtable_rule
methods.description: Adds ebtables NAT PREROUTING rule to redirect diagnostic traffic.

methods.name: del_ebtable_rule
methods.description: Removes the ebtables NAT PREROUTING rule that was added.

methods.name: do_start
methods.description: Performs network setup: stops firewall, configures switch and interfaces, sets up bridge, and starts DHCP if needed.

methods.name: do_stop
methods.description: Performs network teardown: disables interfaces, removes bridge, and unregisters DHCP handlers.

methods.name: do_start_multi
methods.description: Starts multi-net configuration related to LAN.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes configuration variables and interface lists by fetching system parameters.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the bridge service by invoking do_start and performing additional setup actions.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the bridge service by invoking do_stop and cleaning up.
